newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's president returns to Egypt from UAE.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's president returns to Egypt from UAE.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak returned to Egypt on Saturday after a two-day visit to the United Arab Emirates, airport sources said.

Mubarak was accompanied by senior officials including Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on the visit to congratulate President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on his recovery from an operation. Egyptian newspapers said the two leaders discussed the Middle East peace process, investment and agriculture.
